description: Close the adversarial, frontend, local/staging readiness, build, and documentation boundary so the hardened v2 is demonstrably safe without deployment or live integration.
steps: Add deterministic adversarial/privacy/storage failure fixtures and tests for delayed hops, fan-in, structuring/camouflage, crypto replay/forge/expiry/revocation, partial/hub outage, token probing, wrong tenant, malformed/chunked/oversized bodies, feedback poisoning, calibration mismatch, and fenced SQLite failures; prove redacted logs/audits/errors and safe UNKNOWN/local-only outcomes.

Vendor and checksum Cytoscape 3.30.2, add frontend/earlytrace-replay.json, and update frontend/index.html to call the real v2 API with explicit OFFLINE SYNTHETIC REPLAY fallback, safe field rendering, no fake audit receipts, legacy Cases separation, and no runtime network dependency.

Implement sandbox/staging/production_unsupported profiles, readiness/version/health checks, strict CORS/body/request-ID/logging behavior, lock-aware Docker/Makefile local smoke, non-root/no-secret image checks, and no live_integrations=true path.

Update all eight named EarlyTrace documents with the same clearly labelled v1 baseline block, v2 pending/verified status, source/licence/checksum and AI/third-party disclosures, safety invariants, known false negatives/false friction, and no production/DPDP/live-bank/RMSE claims; add docs/readiness/frontend contract tests.
acceptance_criteria: All adversarial paths fail closed or degrade according to the consent/evidence table and no raw identifier/token/PII enters logs, audits, fixtures, metrics, exports, or errors.

The frontend has no CDN/runtime network dependency, renders real v2 responses when available, uses only the deterministic non-raw replay when offline, and cannot invoke legacy case/order/freeze/reverse/reject/report routes.

Staging readiness fails for weak/default secrets, demo keys, missing institution-bound users, in-memory storage, unsafe CORS, live integrations, failed chains, or failed SQLite checks; version reports live_integrations=false without secrets.
All eight docs preserve exact audited v1 numbers and caveats while clearly distinguishing unimplemented or newly measured v2 results.
